_note: Career & lore milestones for the 'Milestones / Misc' screen. `auto` is a rule the checklist engine evaluates against derived state (null = manual tick, with `detection` shown as a hint). Rule types: rank{key,min}, anyRank{keys,min}, allRank{keys,min}, visited{system}, event{events[]}, shipOwned{ship}, moduleOwned{contains}, engineerAny.

milestones.name: Reach Elite in any career
milestones.detail: Reach the Elite tier in any of Combat, Trade, Exploration, Mercenary, Exobiologist, or CQC.

milestones.name: Combat Elite
milestones.detail: Attain Elite in the Combat track.

milestones.name: Trade Elite
milestones.detail: Attain Elite in the Trade track.

milestones.name: Exploration Elite
milestones.detail: Attain Elite in the Exploration track.

milestones.name: Mercenary Elite
milestones.detail: Attain Elite in the Odyssey on-foot combat (Soldier) track.

milestones.name: Exobiologist Elite
milestones.detail: Attain Elite in the Exobiology track.

milestones.name: Triple Elite
milestones.detail: Hold Elite simultaneously in Combat, Trade, and Exploration — awards a unique decal.

milestones.name: Quintuple Elite
milestones.detail: Hold Elite in all five ranked careers (Combat, Trade, Exploration, Mercenary, Exobiologist).

milestones.name: Colonize your first world
milestones.detail: Claim and complete construction of your first system/outpost under the Trailblazers colonization system.

milestones.name: First contact with the Thargoids
milestones.detail: Encounter a Thargoid vessel for the first time.
milestones.detection: CodexEntry with a Thargoid category, or Thargoid kill bonds. No single reliable event — verify manually.

milestones.name: Discover Guardian ruins
milestones.detail: Visit and activate an ancient Guardian ruins or structure site.
milestones.detection: Visit a Synuefe / Col 173 Guardian site; Guardian CodexEntry.

milestones.name: Own a Fleet Carrier
milestones.detail: Purchase your own Drake-class Fleet Carrier (~5 billion credits).

milestones.name: Buy an Anaconda
milestones.detail: Purchase the iconic Anaconda multipurpose ship.

milestones.name: First footfall on an undiscovered planet
milestones.detail: Be the first Commander to set foot on a planetary body (Odyssey).
milestones.detection: Disembark on a previously un-walked body — verify manually.

milestones.name: Unlock the Guardian FSD Booster
milestones.detail: Unlock and fit the Guardian Frame Shift Drive Booster at a Tech Broker.

milestones.name: Pledge to a Power (Powerplay)
milestones.detail: Pledge allegiance to one of the galaxy's Powers.

milestones.name: Earn a permit to Sol
milestones.detail: Obtain access to the Sol system (Federation rank Petty Officer / mission reward).
milestones.detection: FSDJump to Sol, or Federation rank reaching Petty Officer.

milestones.name: Complete a Community Goal
milestones.detail: Contribute to and finish a galaxy-wide Community Goal event.

milestones.name: Reach Colonia
milestones.detail: Travel ~22,000 ly to the Colonia region.

milestones.name: Visit Sagittarius A*
milestones.detail: Reach the supermassive black hole at the galactic centre (~26,000 ly).

milestones.name: Reach Beagle Point
milestones.detail: Reach one of the galaxy's most distant famous waypoints (~65,000 ly).

milestones.name: First Codex discovery
milestones.detail: Log your first Codex entry (astronomical, biological, geological, or xeno).

milestones.name: First neutron-star boost
milestones.detail: Perform your first FSD supercharge through a neutron star's jet cone.

milestones.name: Visit your first tourist beacon
milestones.detail: Read your first tourist beacon in space.

milestones.name: Sample exobiology (first organic scan)
milestones.detail: Complete your first biological sample with the Genetic Sampler (Odyssey).

milestones.name: First planetary landing (Horizons)
milestones.detail: Touch down on the surface of an airless world for the first time.

milestones.name: First surface scan (map a planet)
milestones.detail: Fully map a planetary body with probes for the first-mapped bonus.

milestones.name: Unlock tech at a Tech Broker
milestones.detail: Gather materials and unlock a module or weapon at a Tech Broker (e.g. Guardian tech).

milestones.name: Meet an Engineer / first engineering
milestones.detail: Unlock your first Engineer.
